fields.name: id
fields.description: Planet ID (lowercase, e.g., sun, moon, mercury) or display name (case-insensitive, e.g., Sun, MOON). Spaces, hyphens and underscores are interchangeable, so the two lunar nodes answer to north-node and south-node as well as to their ids north node and south node, and Black Moon Lilith answers to black-moon-lilith as well as to lilith.
